purpose: Curated policy and relationship overrides for the public Unified Scholarly Graph. Descriptive metadata remains authoritative in its domain registry or public mirror; this file stores graph-only decisions.

visibility_policy.note: The raw repository catalogue may contain private-repository metadata. It is used only upstream to derive curated public mirrors and is never serialized into the public scholarly graph.

theme_overrides.match: Statistical distributions for fisheries and marine ecology
